note: SRA on 325-acre Bluestem Reservoir SW of Lincoln. The 39-site electric campground sits inland, 100-160 m from the east shore across scrub and trees; gravel basic pads line the north-east shore with open grass to the water, and a grass basic loop is at the south end, plus about 200 unmarked basic sites. Reservoir levels can run very low in drought. --Claude
summary: Booking changed: not all first-come - ReserveAmerica books 36 sites (20 Electric Plus 50 A, 16 Basic), so reservable with some first-come. Electric 50 A and year-round season confirmed on RA. Lakefront confirmed for the gravel shoreline basic pads (075-079, RA 'Shoreline site: Y'), not the electric campground (300-530 ft back). Fees: RA quotes $30 Electric Plus / $15 Basic for May 2027 - stored high $15 is low (human-read provenance, flagged).
flags: FEES high looks low (not changed; stored fees provenance has no method, i.e. a human read): the stored $10-15 follows the 2025 grid, which marks Bluestem 'Basic' only, but the booking site now sells Electric Plus sites at '$30.00 Per Night' (site 001, Sat 5/1/2027) beside Basic at '$15.00 Per Night' (site 077). Suggest nightly_high 30 and an electric surcharge of 15 (by hand). The 2025 grid predates the electric campground.

BOOKING contradicted the note ('All first-come, first-served'): RA has 36 bookable sites. Only odd numbers 001-039 of the electric campground are listed, which fits the note's 39-site electric campground with the even sites first come; that split is my reading of the numbering, not a stated rule.

WATERFRONT lakefront confirmed for some sites: RA tags basic sites 075-079 (gravel, 63-80 ft) 'Shoreline site: Y' at 'Distance from Shoreline: 10'; on imagery these back-in pads are on the lake side of the shore road with ~30-40 m of open, unused tall grass to the high-water edge (rip-rap/beach), inside the ~50 m bound, so on-water holds. More unnumbered pads continue NW along the same shore. The ELECTRIC campground is not waterfront: RA gives 300-530 ft from shoreline and imagery puts its pads 100-160 m inland behind scrub and a tree mass. Grass basic loop 041-055 at the south end: 40-140 ft from shore for most, across the south loop road - lakeview at most.
SITES: no count written. RA books 36; the note's 39 electric + 19 basic pads + ~200 non-pad sites can't be confirmed from one source. All RA sites take 23 ft (shortest 58 ft).
PHONE: none stored; the 2025 grid gives Bluestem SRA 402-796-2362 (also on Google's listing, 4.5 from 23). Suggest adding by hand.

PIN OK: stored 40.63403,-96.80019 is at the north-west end of the shoreline basic pad row (RA site 075 is ~70 m SE). The electric campground's centre is ~40.6303,-96.7985 (~450 m SSE) if a pin on the main campground is preferred.
GRID OUT OF DATE: the 2025 rates grid shows no reservation mark and Basic only for Bluestem; RA shows Electric Plus and reservations. Worth noting for the state:NE registry reads.

NOTE CLEANED: dropped 'plus a CXT shower house' and 'Drinking water, primitive restrooms, dump/fill station' (facilities), 'All first-come, first-served (self-register at the Iron Ranger)' (booking, contradicted) and 'NE park entry permit required' (fees.entrance via the state:NE policy); added where each campground sits against the water.
